model: ROLEX Cosmograph Daytona 116519LN (40 mm white gold, STEEL-GREY dial with black sub-dials, black Cerachrom tachymetre bezel, three sub-dials, two white gold screw-down pushers, black Oysterflex rubber strap)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (hub screw). Follower of the Daytona 126519LN / 126518LN Oysterflex builds: same step / prep, own kit preset (this photo is a 2880 x 2880 retailer render, different camera and scale, older 116519LN case), own measure / spec / job. White gold case, crown and pushers come through the projected photo (no separate gold material); black ceramic bezel (bezel_emission); steel-grey dial with black sub-dials; black Oysterflex strap as three flat rubber columns (left flared side, raised centre blade, right flared side). Native 2880 px photo, 32.0475 px/mm; steel map scaled 0.82 (2048 px long side), dial map native.

case.note: outline = contour of the photo silhouette between the lug rows (horn top row 537 = 21.12 mm, horn bottom row 2041 = 25.80 mm); the slab slopes toward the strap

bezel.note: bright chamfer bezel_in .. insert_in, ceramic ring to the ellipse ceramic_out (rx 19.63 mm, ry 19.20 mm), polished edge ring to the case flank ellipse (rx 20.0 mm); scale, numerals and reflections are the projected photo

hands.note: hands = picked photo outlines (trace.hands[name].outline_mm) as flat polygons: hour and minute sword hands (black facet and lume strip are photo), chronograph seconds needle with arrow head and paddle tail, the three sub-dial needles with their hub discs; emission = dial emission so the polygons blend into the printed dial

crown.note: fluted Rolex crown (the guards are in the case slab): flutes x 2085..2180 px, cap to 2204 px, axis 1.07 mm below the pivot, 16 coarse flutes

pushers.note: two screw-down pushers on radial axes through trace.pushers.origin_mm at +-28 deg (cap-end centres measured at 25.6 and -28 deg): neck, fluted ring, narrower cylindrical cap

strap.note: Oysterflex rubber strap: columns outer / centre / outer (the photo shows a raised centre blade x 858..1060 px, 20 px longer than the flared sides); the single-column layout was not used because the centre blade ends beyond the sides.

bracelet.note: Oysterflex strap, one rubber piece per column and side (outer_l / outer_r kinds differ only in their end rows). Rows (px, 32.0475 px/mm, pivot (1445, 1214)): outer sides end at row 213 (top, rounded corners) and about 2669 (left) / 2655 (right) at the bottom (the cut end is slanted in this render), centre blade ends at 197 (top) and 2680 (bottom); column lines are the thin bright gradient maxima (top x 1315.6..1305.4 / 1578.3..1588.4 for rows 250..540, bottom x 1295.4..1304.8 / 1584.3..1574.9 for rows 2080..2630), linear between. Outer edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
